label: concurrency-3, fixed launcher
why: The first launch was a dud: `concurrency` never reached the notebook (TASK_SELECTION had no such key) and `_excluded` was a NameError. tools/check_notebook_names.py now fails the workflow before a launch. Same 12 paired tasks, same seed, concurrency 3: does batching four sessions against one vLLM server cost accuracy, and how much wall clock does it save against the serial baseline (5/12, 2919 s, 2 empties)?
